texts.title: Texts
texts.description: One audio file per entry. Through the API you can pass objects {"text": "…", "name": "file-name", "voice": "id-f"} to set a file name or voice per text.
prefill: Hello! This is toowl. Paste any text and get a natural sounding MP3 back.
Selamat datang di toowl. Ubah teks menjadi suara dalam hitungan detik.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: Joe is a neural voice (natural). The others are eSpeak NG (clear but synthetic, very fast).

espeakVoice.title: Other language (eSpeak voice)
espeakVoice.description: Overrides Voice with any eSpeak NG voice: a language code plus an optional variant, e.g. "de", "es+f3", "fr+m1", "ar", "hi", "ja". 100+ languages.

format.title: Output format
format.description: File type of each speech file.

bitrate.title: Bitrate (kbps)
bitrate.description: For MP3, M4A, OGG and Opus.

zip.title: Also as one ZIP
zip.description: Bundle every file into speech-<format>.zip when there are two or more texts.
